title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF has implemented strategic interventions to improve access to quality, inclusive education for all children by initiating a comprehensive curricular reform, creating support services,; building the capacities of education decision-makers and professionals. Significant steps have been taken to advance the digitalization, WASH and green education agendas.
